method: Bounded primary model follows Microsoft PRICE for regular coupon periods, not every traded-bond convention. Exclude odd first/last coupons, ex-coupon periods, inflation-linked amounts and callable yield-to-worst.

Construct regular coupon dates backwards from maturity; preserve maturity day-of-month with end-of-month clamping consistently. Previous coupon<=settlement<next coupon. N counts strictly future coupon dates.

For Actual/Actual, E=actual days previous-to-next coupon, A=actual previous-to-settlement, DSC=actual settlement-to-next. For Actual/360 E=360/frequency; Actual/365 E=365/frequency; A/DSC are actual days. For30/360 E=360/frequency and A/DSC use named date normalization.

US/NASD DAYS360: start month-end becomes30; if end month-end and normalized start<30, end becomes first day of next month, otherwise30. European30/360 changes day31to30 without a February month-end rule. These are explicit software conventions; do not assume all market30/360variants match.
Let C=100*coupon/f, v=1+yield/f. For N>1 dirty=sum(C/v^(k-1+DSC/E),k=1..N)+redemption/v^(N-1+DSC/E). Accrued=C*A/E; clean=dirty-accrued.
For N=1 the Microsoft branch is dirty=(C+redemption)/(1+(yield/f)*(E-A)/E), then subtract accrued. Do not reuse the multi-coupon exponent formula silently.
Yield inverse root-solves CLEAN price under the same branch/day-count rules; report dirty price separately.
validation: Settlement must precede maturity; valid frequency only.
Coupons/redemption positive or zero as appropriate; negative yield can be supported with v>0 but Microsoft documented PRICE rejects negative yield, so declare intended domain.
Do not round dates into a years input; final coupon branch must be tested.

scopeAndDependencies.exactMarketScope: Regular coupons only. Named day-count convention and coupon schedule are part of contract; exact issuer/security exceptions require instrument terms.

method: Build independent tax submodules and compose in statutory order; a field namedincome isnot sufficient to characterize wages,SE,capitalgain,SSbenefits or tax-exemptinterest. Preserve narrow existing wage mode while expanding bounded branches.

Half of those baseSEtaxes isdeductible;additionalMedicare isnot part ofhalfSEdeduction. Church/optionalmethods,RRTA and negative/multiple-business interactionneedseparatebranches.

AdditionalMedicare onSE=0.9%*max(0,SEincome-max(0,statusThreshold-MedicareWages)), coordinatedwithwageAdditionalMedicare;do nottaxsameexcess twice. Employerwithholdingtrigger200000 isnotalways finaltaxstatusthreshold.

Preferential qualifiedgain module: ordinaryTaxable=max(0,taxableIncome-qualifiedPreferentialIncome). Allocate gains into0/15/20percent bandsaboveordinarytaxableincome. NIIT module=3.8%*min(eligibleNetInvestmentIncome,max(0,MAGI-statusThreshold)). Wages/SEearningsarenotautomaticallynetinvestmentincome. Classificationandmaterialparticipationmustbeexplicit.

Child/otherdependent preliminarycredit=max(0,2200*qualifiedChildren+500*otherEligibleDependents-50*ceil(max(0,MAGI-phaseoutThreshold)/1000)). Nonrefundablecredit limitedbyapplicabletaxcreditlimit;ACTCbasicbranch=min(remainingEligibleCredit,1700*children,15%*max(0,earnedIncome-2500));threechild/PuertoRico/foreignincomeandothercreditinteractionbranchesneedfullSchedule8812.

TentativeMinimumTax=26%first244500taxableAMTI(122250MFS)+28%rest,withqualifiedgainspecialcalculation. AdditionalAMT=max(0,TMT-appropriateRegularTaxAfterRequiredAdjustments),notTMTaddedwhole.
